This is a prototype page for the `cancer-on-ice` "Catchment Lake": population cancer
data stored as Apache Iceberg tables, read anonymously straight from object storage
through an Iceberg REST catalog (`icegate`). The map below runs entirely in your
browser — DuckDB compiled to WebAssembly attaches the catalog and queries it live; no
server renders this page's data, and nothing you do here is sent anywhere but
Cloudflare's edge (the R2 bucket + the icegate worker).

## Live county map

::: {.callout-note}
This map runs a live query against `coi.measure.observation` — a 23-million-row
table — directly in your browser via DuckDB-WASM. Large-table reads like this can
fail intermittently in a long-lived tab (a resource-accumulation limit in this
DuckDB-WASM build, not a bug in this query — see
[cancer-on-ice#120](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/issues/120)). If the
map below shows an error, click Retry, or reload the page.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
CATALOG_ENDPOINT = "https://icegate-canceronice.seandavi.workers.dev"

measures = [
  { measure_id: "PLACES:CSMOKING:age_adjusted", label: "Current cigarette smoking (age-adjusted %)" },
  { measure_id: "PLACES:COLON_SCREEN:age_adjusted", label: "Colorectal cancer screening (age-adjusted %)" },
  { measure_id: "PLACES:MAMMOUSE:age_adjusted", label: "Mammography use (age-adjusted %)" }
]
releases = ["2025", "2024"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof measureId = Inputs.select(measures, {
  label: "Measure",
  format: (d) => d.label,
  value: measures[0]
})
viewof release = Inputs.select(releases, { label: "Release" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sql = `SELECT geo_id, value, lower, upper, value_status
FROM coi.measure.observation
WHERE source = 'PLACES'
  AND source_release = '${release}'
  AND measure_id = '${measureId.measure_id}'
  AND geo_id LIKE 'county:%'
  AND stratum_id = 'PLACES:ALL'
  AND valid_to IS NULL`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Retry control: incrementing this mutable is the ONLY thing that rebuilds dbState
// below. Selector changes (measure/release) never touch it — they only re-run
// queryState, reusing the same connection. This is deliberate: our own diagnosis
// (cancer-on-ice#120 / PR #119) found that "RangeError: Maximum call stack size
// exceeded" came from stacking several undisposed DuckDB-WASM instances in one tab
// during testing, not from any one query — so this page runs exactly one instance
// and one connection for its whole lifetime, and Retry fully tears down and rebuilds
// that single instance rather than layering a second one on top of it.
mutable dbGeneration = 0
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
retryButton = {
  const btn = html`<button>Retry connection</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => { mutable dbGeneration = dbGeneration + 1; };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Loads the SAME pinned duckdb-wasm build the explorer app uses (Quarto's own OJS
// stdlib DuckDBClient is an older bundled client that cannot ATTACH an Iceberg REST
// catalog — see the PR description for the exact dead end). Depends only on
// dbGeneration, so it runs once per page load and again only on Retry.
dbState = {
  dbGeneration; // reactive dependency — Retry increments this to rebuild the instance
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const duckdb = await import(
      "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.33.1-dev57.0/dist/duckdb-browser.mjs"
    );
    const bundle = await duckdb.selectBundle(duckdb.getJsDelivrBundles());
    const tBundle = performance.now();
    const workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob([`importScripts("${bundle.mainWorker}");`], { type: "text/javascript" })
    );
    const worker = new Worker(workerUrl);
    const db = new duckdb.AsyncDuckDB(new duckdb.ConsoleLogger(duckdb.LogLevel.WARNING), worker);
    await db.instantiate(bundle.mainModule, bundle.pthreadWorker);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
    const conn = await db.connect();
    const tInstantiate = performance.now();
    await conn.query("INSTALL iceberg; LOAD iceberg; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;");
    const tExtensions = performance.now();
    await conn.query(
      `ATTACH 'canceronice' AS coi (TYPE ICEBERG, ENDPOINT '${CATALOG_ENDPOINT}', AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none');`
    );
    const tAttach = performance.now();
    // Tear this instance down fully before the cell is ever replaced (a future Retry,
    // or navigating away) — never leave a stale worker + WASM heap running alongside
    // a new one.
    invalidation.then(async () => {
      try { await conn.close(); } catch {}
      try { await db.terminate(); } catch {}
    });
    return {
      status: "ready",
      conn,
      timings: {
        bundleSelect: tBundle - t0,
        instantiate: tInstantiate - tBundle,
        extensions: tExtensions - tInstantiate,
        attach: tAttach - tExtensions,
        total: tAttach - t0
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function rowsFromArrow(table) {
  const fields = table.schema.fields.map((f) => f.name);
  return table.toArray().map((r) => {
    const o = {};
    for (const f of fields) {
      let v = r[f];
      if (typeof v === "bigint") v = Number(v);
      o[f] = v;
    }
    return o;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState = {
  if (dbState.status !== "ready") return dbState;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const result = await dbState.conn.query(sql);
    const rows = rowsFromArrow(result);
    return { status: "ready", rows, ms: performance.now() - t0 };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// County boundaries live nowhere in the lake (it holds tabular data, not geometry).
// Loaded once, at view time, from a public TopoJSON CDN.
countyGeo = {
  const topojsonMod = await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3/+esm");
  const us = await fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/us-atlas@3/counties-10m.json").then((r) => r.json());
  return topojsonMod.feature(us, us.objects.counties);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
joined = {
  if (queryState.status !== "ready") return null;
  const byFips = new Map(queryState.rows.map((r) => [r.geo_id.replace("county:", ""), r]));
  return countyGeo.features.map((f) => {
    const obs = byFips.get(f.id);
    return { ...f, properties: { ...f.properties, fips: f.id, obs } };
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="proto-status">
  ${dbState.status === "error"
    ? html`<p style="color:#b00"><strong>Catalog unreachable:</strong> ${dbState.error?.message ?? dbState.error}. The live map cannot load — this page is telling you rather than rendering blank.</p><p>${retryButton}</p>`
    : dbState.status !== "ready"
    ? html`<p><em>Connecting to the catalog and loading DuckDB-WASM…</em></p>`
    : queryState.status === "error"
    ? html`<p style="color:#b00"><strong>Query failed:</strong> ${queryState.error?.message ?? queryState.error}</p><p>${retryButton}</p>`
    : queryState.status !== "ready"
    ? html`<p><em>Running query…</em></p>`
    : html`<p><small>DuckDB-WASM ready in ${dbState.timings.total.toFixed(0)} ms (bundle+worker ${dbState.timings.instantiate.toFixed(0)} ms, extensions ${dbState.timings.extensions.toFixed(0)} ms, ATTACH ${dbState.timings.attach.toFixed(0)} ms). This query: ${queryState.ms.toFixed(0)} ms, ${queryState.rows.length} rows.</small></p>`}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
joined
  ? Plot.plot({
      projection: "albers-usa",
      color: {
        type: "sequential",
        scheme: "blues",
        label: measureId.label,
        legend: true,
        nice: true
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.geo(joined, {
          fill: (d) =>
            !d.properties.obs
              ? null
              : d.properties.obs.value_status !== "reported"
              ? null
              : d.properties.obs.value,
          stroke: "white",
          strokeWidth: 0.3,
          title: (d) => {
            const o = d.properties.obs;
            if (!o) return `${d.properties.name} (${d.properties.fips}): no data`;
            if (o.value_status !== "reported")
              return `${d.properties.name} (${d.properties.fips}): ${o.value_status.replace(/_/g, " ")} — no value`;
            return `${d.properties.name} (${d.properties.fips})\n${measureId.label}: ${o.value}% (CI ${o.lower}–${o.upper})\nrelease ${release}`;
          }
        }),
        // Counties present in the boundary file but with no row, or a row whose value
        // isn't "reported" (suppressed etc.), drawn hatched/grey instead of as zero.
        Plot.geo(
          joined.filter((d) => !d.properties.obs || d.properties.obs.value_status !== "reported"),
          { fill: "#ddd", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.3, fillOpacity: 0.6 }
        )
      ],
      width: 900,
      height: 550,
      caption:
        "Connecticut's eight legacy counties (topojson boundary set) don't match PLACES 2024/2025's nine planning regions, so Connecticut shows as no-data here — that boundary-vintage mismatch is exactly what the lake's geo_vintage column exists to make explicit, not something to paper over."
    })
  : html`<p><em>Map will render once the query returns.</em></p>`
```

### Ten lowest counties

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState.status === "ready"
  ? Inputs.table(
      queryState.rows
        .filter((d) => d.value_status === "reported")
        .sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value)
        .slice(0, 10)
        .map((d) => ({ geo_id: d.geo_id, value: d.value, lower: d.lower, upper: d.upper })),
      { columns: ["geo_id", "value", "lower", "upper"] }
    )
  : html`<p><em>Table will render once the query returns.</em></p>`
```
